create.name: Giovanni Dienstmann
create.bio:
Giovanni Dienstmann is a meditation teacher, coach and author whose daily sitting practice goes back to the year 2000, when he was a teenager. Over the years he took formal initiation in Zen, Advaita, Raja Yoga and mantra practice, spent ten weeks at a monastery in France, trained with the Satyananda School of Yoga and gained teacher certification through the Meditation Association of Australia. His yogic and tantric study continued with initiations from Shivarudra Balayogi and in the lineage of Swami Nikhileshwarananda. He first became known through LiveAndDare, a long-running meditation blog, and later through Higher Mind, where he now works.

His approach treats meditation as a source of strength as well as calm: alongside stillness and letting go, he teaches values, purpose, willpower and steady self-discipline drawn from wisdom traditions and psychology. He wrote Practical Meditation, an illustrated beginner's guide from DK, followed by Mindful Self-Discipline and Wise Confidence. Today he works mostly through one-to-one online coaching, including a newer programme on sankalpa, the yogic art of setting and charging an intention, and through his app and newsletter. On Insight Timer he shares guided meditations, self-enquiry and talks in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

videos.title: Designing Your Best Life: The Mindful Approach to Self-Discipline

books.title: Practical Meditation: A Simple Step-by-Step Guide
books.author: Giovanni Dienstmann
books.description: An illustrated beginner's handbook from DK that walks through a wide range of meditation styles, from mantra and breath to walking practice. It explains how to choose a method, build a daily habit and work with common obstacles on the cushion.

books.title: Mindful Self-Discipline: Living with Purpose and Achieving Your Goals in a World of Distractions
books.author: Giovanni Dienstmann
books.description: Dienstmann sets out an awareness-based way of keeping commitments, rooted in values and purpose rather than force. Mindfulness practices sit alongside planning tools for living by what matters to you.

books.title: Wise Confidence: Overcome Self-Doubt and Build Lasting Self-Esteem
books.author: Giovanni Dienstmann
books.description: Published by Sounds True, this book looks at courage, self-belief and determination through the lens of meditation and contemplative wisdom. It offers reflections and exercises for acting from a steady inner centre.

courses.title: Sankalpa Coaching
courses.description: One-to-one training in sankalpa, the method of forming and empowering an intention as taught in the yogic and tantric lineages he was initiated into. He frames it as a traditional discipline rather than law of attraction. Starts with a free discovery call.

courses.title: Self-Discipline Coaching
courses.description: Personal online coaching built around his book Mindful Self-Discipline. Sessions help you clarify your values and follow through on them without harshness.

courses.title: Meditation Coaching (Online Meditation Classes) with Giovanni
courses.description: Private online sessions for building or deepening a meditation practice, matched to your temperament. Suited to beginners and to practitioners who feel stuck.

courses.title: Virtues: 10 Superpowers To Improve Your Life
courses.description: A ten-part Insight Timer course in which he explores one inner quality per day and how to grow it through practice. Short talks are paired with simple reflections.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Giovanni Dienstmann on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations, I AM self-enquiry, yoga nidra and short talks, free to hear in the app or on the web. Some courses are also offered in Portuguese and Spanish.

free_resources.title: 23 Types of Meditation
free_resources.description: A long free guide on his LiveAndDare blog surveying meditation styles from Buddhist, Hindu, Taoist and modern sources. Each entry explains how the practice is done and who it might suit.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditations - Live and Dare
free_resources.description: Four free recordings from his paid programme, including a body-heaviness practice, a tantric focus on the gap between thoughts and an I AM self-enquiry. A good way to sample his voice and style.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 32.5k (profile via WebFetch, 31 Oct 2026); YouTube 9.03K subscribers (channel /videos page, 31 Oct 2026); no own Instagram/Facebook/X/TikTok linked from his sites (he says he uses no social apps) → ~41.5k total → local_hero
flags: His current focus is mostly self-discipline and confidence coaching (Higher Mind); meditation and yogic/tantric teaching remain real but are now a smaller share of his output.
Insight Timer gives his base as Kollam, Kerala, India, but no physical venue or in-person classes are offered now (Monk Week retreat has no date), so availability is worldwide.
WebFetch quoted only the first 125 characters of his Insight Timer bio; bio check relied mainly on his own site pages.
The single photo is the same headshot used on Insight Timer, YouTube and his coaching page (only one distinct image found).
Most YouTube uploads are Shorts or book/app promos; only one longer teaching video kept.
left_out: Insight Timer tracks titled for sleep, immunity/coronavirus and emotional emergency (anxiety) left out under the health-claim rule (tracks aren't listed anyway).
Monk Week Retreat left out: no date or place set (waiting list only) and it includes fasting challenges.
Overcome Procrastination coaching and Wise Confidence coaching left out as mainly productivity/confidence coaching; Self-Discipline Coaching kept as one example.
Portuguese and Spanish Insight Timer courses left out (English listing).
No coaching prices are published (discovery-call model), so 'Contact for pricing'.
YouTube Shorts and 1–3 minute book testimonial clips left out (under ~2 minutes or not teaching); Roy Baumeister interview left out (he is the interviewer).
